answer.summary: A narrow, empirically grounded research question on memory decay under bounded token budgets is proposed to isolate observable patterns in state persistence without relying on unreported or missing metrics.
answer.content: Investigate how memory decay manifests in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, focusing exclusively on the rate of token reduction per update interval and its correlation with observed state drift, using only explicitly reported token usage and retention trends from available source data in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1. This query avoids unverified metrics and centers on observable, data-anchored dynamics of memory erosion under constrained resources.
